title: Jericho
summary: Jericho the head of monks is a powerful flying Hecto-Titan whose appearance is that of a large skeleton abbot made up of long, protruding bones. Jericho was the primary Titan of Tantras, a senior member of the Blood Spiral Brotherhood, before his Amulet was passed on to Harrison Fears.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Tantras invoked Jericho on the Erasmus Bridge in Rotterdam to assist his Orphan recruits in attacking the Huntik team. Jericho swooped and knocked down Zhalia Moon and, after absorbing an energy blast from Cherit, fought and was defeated by Zhalia's King Basilisk. [Den vs Harrison]

At the Blood Spiral Base, Tantras used Jericho whilst training Harrison Fears. After fighting against Harrison's Hitokiri, Jericho was called back to his Amulet at the end of the sparring session. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

After losing all his power to the Heart of Vlad Dracul, Tantras gave Jericho's Amulet to Harrison alongside Bazela's Hive. Harrison later invoked Jericho in Egypt to ambush vehicles of a team of Huntik Foundation operatives and free their prisoner, Rassimov. When the Huntik team arrived, Jericho was pinned down by Umbra the Shadow Jaguar and defeated by Dante Vale. [Rassimov's Secret]

Jericho was summoned by Harrison when he and Den were facing off against the Betrayer where he fought against the Legendary Titan of Betrayal, Demigorgan, alongside Dullahan. After Harrison ran to protect a weak Zhalia Moon, about to take an attack from the Betrayer, Jericho rushed in front of Harrison and took the blow instead, sending Jericho back to its Amulet. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E47 Jericho car.png|thumb|Jericho is able to impale vehicles, stopping them|173x173px]]
Jericho is an extremely powerful Titan. In addition to flying quickly through the air, Jericho can swoop down and impale his enemies on the massive spikes on his body, or even use them as direct weapons. {{source|Den vs Harrison}} Jericho can also absorb energy attacks, such as Cherit's Energy Charge, making him be difficult to defeat. Despite this, the Betrayer's [[Shocklash]] spell was able to take him out. {{source|Boys Will Be Seekers}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* His summoning command is "'''Corrupt everything'''".
* Jericho is based on the biblical city of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jericho Jericho], whose walls were said to be almost indestructible. His appearance, specifically his hat and robe, is based on that of a head monk.
* Jericho was referred to as as "Jericho: Head of Monks" and "Jericho the Skeleton Monk" in his concept art.
